==Biography==
He was educated first at [[Christ's Hospital]], where he won the Thompson Gold Medal for mathematics, and later at [[King's College, Cambridge]]. He was elected a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] in 1951 and awarded its [[Sylvester Medal]] in 1961. He was President of the [[London Mathematical Society]] from 1955&ndash;1957, and was awarded its [[Berwick Prizes|Berwick Prize]] in 1958 and [[De Morgan Medal]] in 1965.<ref name="mactutor">{{MacTutor Biography|id=Hall}}</ref><ref name="mathgene">{{MathGenealogy|id=18253}}</ref>
